Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

CanvasPlotHost has a pixel-scale correction and surface replacement logic, but CanvasLayers still allocates the component’s canvases without a global byte-accounting or eviction budget. A per-surface scale fix does not cap the combined Prism texture allocation that this ticket names. Keep the ticket open for an explicit total budget across all three layers, a deterministic degradation policy, and a test that exercises an 8192-pixel surface without exhausting the pool.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/CanvasPlotHost.scala:155
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/CanvasPlotHost.scala:510
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/plot/CanvasPlotHostFxSuite.scala:53

Remaining / next action: Implement aggregate texture-byte accounting/budget and a deterministic exhaustion regression.

Disposition: Keep open.
